confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Koh Samui price levels, not from live menus, listings or booking pages; no web search was used for the city prices. Cafe, beer and casual-meal anchors are the most reliable. The mid-range two-person meal and both hotel anchors are least certain because room rates vary widely by property, season and booking channel, and the accommodation figures assume a typical July rate. Cocktail and wine anchors were inferred from the beer level using typical bar-to-beer price ratios because direct knowledge of Samui bar prices is weak. The FX value came from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates overview for 13 October 2026; that page and the F11.1 table were not opened, and no 14 October observation was checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Estimates were positioned against other Thai island resort towns and mainland Thai tourist cities: food and drink near mainland tourist-city levels, with an island premium on bar drinks and accommodation.
